details:
Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is a proposed educational project designed to introduce students to astronaut training and space exploration. It aims to provide an interactive learning experience where students can understand the basic skilss and preparations needed for space missions.

The project is designed to include different learning activities related to astronaut training, such as mission preparation, problem-solving, teamwork, and understanding the space environment.

Its main benefit is to make learning about space more interesting, enjoyable, and accesible to students. The intended impact is to encourage curiosity, creativity, critical thinking, and interest in science and technology

At this stage, the project is still in the planning and development stage, and a physical prototype has not yet been built. Canva and CapCut are used to prepare the project's presentation and visual materials.

The creativity of this project comes from combining space exploration concepts with interactive educational activities. Our team considers student safely, learning effectiveness, accessibility, and creativity when planning the project.
